label: Protectli Vault Pro VP4670 (6-port 2.5G)
description: Fanless six-port Vault Pro built on an Intel i7-10810U with six Intel i226-V 2.5GbE RJ45 ports and no wireless; the highest-port-count 2.5G Vault Pro.
notes: 6x 2.5G, i7-10810U, M.2 NVMe + 2.5in SATA, 16GB eMMC, micro-USB console. The VP4600 family are 6-port 2.5G boxes (VP4630/VP4630e/VP4650/VP4670); only CPU differs, so this spec covers the family at the top SKU.
